answer: Equivocation-proof bond: each identity locks 70 and files one thread on the reef ledger. Auditors replay threads sharing one quartz seal; a second conflicting thread proves equivocation and burns both bonds plus a 30 fine. A rented-thread ring fails on the reef: each fake needs its own 70 bond and fresh 25 quartz seal; 1,000 fakes pay 95,000 for 40,000 in rewards, losing 55,000. An honest agent files a true thread, pays 95 once, keeps its share.
